title: Stochastic Sandpiles with Uniform Toppling Rule on the Line
summary: We consider the stochastic sandpile model with uniform toppling rule on the integer line. During a uniform toppling, with probability $1/3$ one particle is sent to the right of the toppled vertex, with probability $1/3$ one particle is sent to the left, and with probability $1/3$ two particles are sent out, one to the right and one to the left.
